# Trademarks

## Overview
This page outlines the preliminary trademark clearance and legal review for product and feature names associated with [Aurora Labs](./aurora-labs.md) and [TeaBuddy](./teabuddy.md), as evaluated by shared legal counsel.

## Key Details
* **MeshSync:** Cleared with a caveat regarding similar existing mesh [IoT](./iot.md) marks.
* **TeaBuddy:** Cleared in Class 21 for kitchen gadgets.
* **"Puck":** Too crowded for standalone use; must be used together as "[TeaBuddy Puck](./teabuddy.md)".
* **"[Nova](./aurora-labs.md)":** Conflicts with an existing tech mark when used alone; must be used as "[Nova Widget](./nova-widget.md)".
* **"SteepSync":** Rejected internally (noted as already rejected by Alex).
* **Co-marketing:** Approved on the condition that logos maintain a minimum separation of 24 pixels.
